name: Squallmow
description: Draw the blade up with a first cut that leaves a second cut ready on the opposite hand.

name: Squallscrub
description: Slide both heels together across the ground and bring the blade round with the hips.

name: Thickbelly Pledge
description: Cross the wrists with the blade between them to stop a cut on both forearms.

name: Matchless Wideback
description: Slash with qi fed to the edge on the first beat and the spine on the second.

name: Delugebush
description: Parry the opponent's stroke and return the cut on the same beat as the parry ends.

name: Cutback Troth
description: Hook the foe's weapon with the curve and mirror the hook with the free hand.

name: Peal Mow
description: Rap the opponent's guard twice on the beat before they begin a stroke.

name: Haemal Brushedge
description: Bring the blade down in two linked drops that fell the guard and the arm behind it.

name: Vineseal
description: Retreat behind a paired screen of qi held along both sides of the blade.

name: Vaunted Chopedge
description: Pierce the seam between two defenses with both tracks of qi run into a single point.

name: Vigor Bluntspine
description: Cut with both hands and both tracks of qi so that the first and second cuts land as one.

name: Vineedict
description: Draw the blade up from low in the stance as water rises from a basin.

name: Mowboon
description: Slide from one footing to the next as down terraced ground and keep the blade level.

name: Prism Weightedge
description: Raise the blade as a rim around the body to catch cuts that fall into it.

name: Squall Brushcut
description: Slash with qi welling up from below as a spring feeds a basin.

name: Parity Rivetgrip
description: Turn the blade in a valley-shaped parry that funnels a cut to one side.

name: Titan Machhilt
description: Hook the foe's weapon through a veil of qi mist and pull it down and in.

name: Vigor Lashdown
description: Let the gathered qi overflow into the edge for a cut that goes deeper than its swing.

name: Vinecrown
description: Sweep low across the valley floor and cut every foe standing in its path.

name: Weightedge Reliquary
description: Draw the force of a blow into the body's basin and hold it for the next stroke.

name: Vaunted Solar Clearcut
description: Release the whole brimming basin of qi in one cut that fans out across the foes ahead.

name: Steel Heavytang
description: Open with a light cut that sets the foe's guard for the heavy stroke to follow.

name: Venerable Widetip
description: Hold the blade at the centre of the court and give no ground to a rush.

name: Bluntspine Heraldry
description: Cross from one side of the court to the other in two quick steps.

name: Commanding Cutback
description: Rap the foe's blade away from the centre and open the court to a cut.

name: Scrubtriumph
description: Set the opponent's weight with a qi-fed cut that leaves a clear line to the felling drop.

name: Immaculate Machhilt
description: Fold the blade across the body in a parry that turns the cut and readies the counter.

name: Sigilvine
description: Pin the foe's weapon between the blade and the free forearm and hold it fast.

name: Thunderclap Rivetgrip
description: Check the opponent's breath with a short cut at the moment they draw it in.

name: Brushedge Decree
description: Bring the blade down in the court's secret line and fell the guard before it can set.

name: Famed Widetip
description: Sweep from corner to corner of the court in one low pass that cuts all within it.

name: Radiance Thickbelly
description: Flash across the whole court in a blink and cut the foe from the far side.

name: Scrubdecree
description: Fell the foe with the school's secret stroke in which both courts' cuts fall as one.

name: Matchless Heavytang
description: Draw the blade in a flowing line that follows the foe as a river follows its bed.

name: Vigorweed
description: Step along a bank close to cover and keep the blade's tip trained on the foe.

name: Crushing Chopedge
description: Hold the blade in a swaying guard like reeds that bend and do not break.

name: Heroic Lashdown
description: Slash along the line of the riverbed with qi following the stroke's whole length.

name: Parity Wideback
description: Parry with a quick churning turn of the blade that breaks the cut in several directions.

name: Imperious Clearcut
description: Hook the foe in a small circle and drag their weapon round the eddy.

name: Tyrannous Hacksweep
description: Catch the foe's stroke on the current of the blade and check it mid-flow.

name: Quenched Brushcut
description: Cut round the bend of the guard and fell the foe from the side it was not covering.

name: Demolition Hacksweep
description: Sweep in several joined arcs like tributaries meeting and cut the foes standing between them.

name: Retribution Chopedge
description: Cut along a hidden current of qi that runs beneath the foe's guard.

name: Tenetbush
description: Chain a bank cut and an eddy hook and a felling drop in one motion that the river carries.

name: Vigor Clearcut
description: Draw the blade from a high stance as a hawk takes the air above its prey.

name: Squall Widetip
description: Step up onto a rise of ground and keep the blade above the foe's line.

name: Sundering Heavytang
description: Cover the body with the flat of the blade and the thin edge of the field.

name: Noble Machhilt
description: Slash with a crown of qi that rides above the edge and widens the cut.

name: Weedvow
description: Rise on the toes and lift the blade in a parry that sends a cut skyward.

name: Savage Bluntspine
description: Fix the foe with a hawk's gaze and bind their weapon with a short hooked cut.

name: Bushcrown
description: Stoop from above with the crown of the field behind the blade and fell the foe.

name: Magma Lashdown
description: Sweep the field out wide like a hawk's wings and cut every foe beneath.

name: Nightmare Mow
description: Pass the blade and body through the foe's guard as a hawk passes through cloud.

name: Majestic Wideback Triumph
description: Drive the school's crowning stoop through the foe's guard with the whole field behind the point.

name: Haemalweed
description: Draw the blade with qi rising from the Core into the arms in an even stream.

name: Vineboon
description: Step on the beat of the Core's pulse and keep both tracks of qi even.

name: Steel Thickbelly
description: Hold the blade with qi drawn from the Core to a steady cover over the chest.

name: Gracious Rivetgrip
description: Match the Core's breath to the foe's and feel which of them is the first to tire.

name: Inferno Weightedge
description: Slash with qi drawn straight from the Core so the stroke never thins.

name: Squall Rivetgrip
description: Parry with both tracks of the Core's qi held in balance against the blow.

name: Sigilscrub
description: Hook the foe's weapon and bind it with a steady draw of qi from the Core.

name: Commanding Mow
description: Break the foe's rhythm with a cut that lands on the beat of the Core.

name: Magnificent Brushedge
description: Fell the foe with a pair of drops that both draw on a single source.

name: Mighty Weightedge
description: Hold a screen of Core-fed field qi round the body while the blade moves.

name: Thunderclap Brushcut
description: Open a rift in the foe's guard with both tracks of the Core driven into one point.

name: Fearless Hacksweep
description: Gather the Core's pair of tracks to one point and loose them together in the canon's stroke.

name: Weedbanner
description: Draw the brush edge as the oath is spoken in the breath before the cut.

name: Spectral Widetip
description: Plant the foot as if on an oath and step forward without turning away.

name: Inviolate Wideback
description: Hold the brush edge up before the face and take a blow on it.

name: Valiant Brushcut
description: Slash with a breath of qi sworn to the edge and carried until the stroke ends.

name: Parity Machhilt
description: Check the foe's cut with a parry held as if bound by oath not to yield.

name: Sigil Hacksweep
description: Hook the foe's weapon and hold it under an oath not to let it go.

name: Bedrock Chopedge
description: Fell the foe with the full sworn weight of the brush edge in one downward cut.

name: Magnificent Lashdown
description: Sweep the sworn edge wide in an arc that cuts every foe within it.

name: Wraithlike Cutback
description: Flash to the foe along the line of the oath and cut as the stroke lands.

name: Haemal Bluntspine
description: Cut the oath into the foe with the school's stroke that does not stop until it is finished.

name: Steel Clearcut
description: Draw the blade with the wind at the back and lean the whole body into the cut.

name: Ruinous Cutback
description: Set the feet to face the wind and step along it toward the foe.

name: Venerable Heavytang
description: Raise the blade over the brow as against a gale and take a cut on its spine.

name: Lifegiving Weightedge
description: Feel the wind along the edge and learn where the foe's stroke will turn it.

name: Vinebanner
description: Slash on a gust of qi that quickens the cut at its last third.

name: Sainted Brushedge
description: Check the foe's cut with a parry timed to the shift of the wind.

name: Rending Thickbelly
description: Snare the foe's weapon in a turn of the blade that pulls like a gale.

name: Masterful Mow
description: Break the foe's stroke with a sudden cut timed like a gust on still air.

name: Inferno Clearcut
description: Fell the foe with the school's secret line of the plateau wind.

name: Fierce Lashdown
description: Rake the wind through the foes with a wide low sweep of the blade.

name: Gallant Hacksweep
description: Open a rift in the foe's guard with a thin lance of the plateau's wind.

name: Magma Machhilt
description: Gather the whole wind of the plateau into the blade and loose it in one broad cut.

name: Mowtriumph
description: Draw the blade straight along a bearing taken on the foe's centre.

name: Searing Rivetgrip
description: Pivot on one foot to a new bearing and bring the blade round to face it.

name: Crushing Wideback
description: Hold the guard along the foe's heading so that every cut meets it first.

name: Vineverdict
description: Slash along the held heading on a gale of qi that stays true to the line.

name: Pealscrub
description: Turn the bearing in a parry that points the foe's cut away from the body.

name: Authoritative Bluntspine
description: Hook the foe's weapon and bind it to a heading chosen by the cutter.

name: Thunderclap Thickbelly
description: Cut across the foe's bearing and break the line of their advance.

name: Scrubbanner
description: Fell the foe along the held bearing with a gale of qi poured into the drop.

name: Fearless Widetip
description: Sweep through the wind along the bearing and cut each foe that stands on it.

name: Titan Heavytang
description: Take the gale of a blow into the held bearing and hold its force for the return cut.

name: Peerless Chopedge Triumph
description: Fell the foe with the school's secret stroke that falls on the bearing and the gale at once.

name: Exalted Cutback
description: Draw the blade already bound to the stroke it will finish.

name: Savage Brushcut
description: Set the feet to the ground as a promise and step only forward or aside.

name: Bedrock Wideback
description: Raise the guard as sworn and let nothing past it that does not break it.

name: Scrubvow
description: Rap the foe's wrist with the flat to shake their grip and their will.

name: Vaunted Mow
description: Slash with qi that has been bound to the whole stroke from its first inch.

name: Pealbush
description: Turn the foe's cut with a parry that stays bound to their blade until it clears.

name: Colossal Weightedge
description: Hook the foe's weapon and hold it under a steady oath of pressure.

name: Mowseal
description: Check the foe's beat with a cut that arrives a moment before their own.

name: Royal Brushedge
description: Fell the foe with an oath-bound drop that is committed from the first motion.

name: Demolition Brushcut
description: Sweep the bound edge around the body and cut all who stand within its sworn arc.

name: Vacuumscrub
description: Cut a rift through the foe's defense by an oath that no guard can answer.

name: Symphonic Mow Verdict
description: Chain draw and parry and drop as one oath that is sworn before it is cut.

name: Steelmow
description: Draw the blade with the arm raised high as a crown above the head.

name: Deluge Machhilt
description: Step forward with the chin raised and the wind at the shoulders.

name: Weedtroth
description: Hold the open blade out in the air and let the foe's cut meet it there.

name: Steelvine
description: Slash beneath a crown of field wind that thickens the stroke.

name: Parity Thickbelly
description: Parry with the crown of wind swirled about the blade and turn the cut away.

name: Lashdown Vow
description: Hook the foe's weapon on the open blade and draw it out and down.

name: Steel Rivetgrip
description: Bring the crowned wind down with the blade and fell the guard.

name: Solar Chopedge
description: Sweep the crown of wind around in one great arc that cuts every foe.

name: Phantasm Cutback
description: Pass through the foe's guard on the crown of the wind as though no blade stood there.

name: Vaunted Thunderclap Widetip
description: Drive the school's crowning wind through the foe's guard in one thin and pitiless line.

name: Scrubcrown
description: Draw the blade as a gale rises from the Core and runs out through the arms.

name: Silken Hacksweep
description: Step on the Core's breath and let the gale carry the weight of the body.

name: Bedrock Brushedge
description: Hold the guard with a gale drawn up from the Core and braced against the blow.

name: Mowdecree
description: Slash with the Core's gale poured into the edge for a stroke that never thins.

name: Stately Bluntspine
description: Parry with a gale sworn to the Core that sends the foe's cut wide.

name: Sigil Heavytang
description: Bind the foe's weapon in a gale of qi drawn from the Core.

name: Chopedge Troth
description: Throw off the foe's stroke with a sudden gust of qi from the Core.

name: Splendid Brushcut
description: Fell the foe with a Core-fed gale poured into a single heavy drop.

name: Ruinous Clearcut
description: Sweep a Core-fed gale through the blade and cut all that it reaches.

name: Animascrub
description: Cut a rift by a Core-sworn oath that the foe's defense cannot answer.

name: Intrepid Wideback Crown
description: Gather the Core's gale on a sworn bearing and loose it in one stroke of the canon.
